gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the default classification level for my project to ensure it aligns with our organizational standards.
gold.ideal: The response should return the current default classification level for the specified project, including its ID and description.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I need to update the default classification level for my project to reflect recent changes in our classification criteria.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful update of the default classification level and return the updated classification details.

gold.user: As a compliance officer, I want to remove the default classification level for a project that no longer requires it to maintain accurate project classifications.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful removal of the default classification level and indicate that the project is now without a default classification.
